competences.description: Attacks all enemies 4 times to inflict Continuous Damage for 2 turns on each hit and destroy the enemy's MAX HP by 30% of the damage dealt.
Attacks the enemy with the most destroyed HP and deals damage that ignores Defense in proportion to the target’s destroyed HP.

Decreases the Critical Damage received by 50%. If the damage taken from an enemy is 10% or less than the boss's MAX HP, the chance of being granted with any effects from the enemy is decreased by 70%. [Automatic Effect]
At the start of its turn, all other allies team up to attack the enemy with the most destroyed HP. [Automatic Effect]
